title: Sticks to Torches
description: Allows you to light sticks using fire or soul fire, converting them to torches
body: # | DESCRIPTION | Allows you to right click on a fire with a stick to light it and make a torch, and allows you to make a soul torch with soul fire. # | VERSIONS | Currently supports Minecraft Java ```1.21.11```. # | COMPATIBILITY | It's a mod so it should be fine, it just adds a right click interaction that happens with a stick on either fire or soul fire. ## | Patreon | Join my new Patreon to support my projects!
